The '''Pesteran-Astorian War''' was a later anti-Astorian conflict linked in source material to the consequences of the [[Bakorian War]].

== Background ==

Astoria's 1935 victory over the [[Bakorian Republic]] and annexation of [[Azmetan]] destabilized northern [[Viridia]] and alarmed neighboring states. The Bakorian War source says the result directly triggered the Pesteran-Astorian War.

The extracted song page for ''Come out ye' black and whites'' treats the conflict as central to Perastan anti-Astorian memory and refers to the Perastan Republican Army. It does not by itself fix the war's full date range or final state combatants.

== Naming Note ==

The source set varies between Pesteran, Perastan, and Perasta-related forms. This draft uses ''Pesteran-Astorian War'' because that is the title used in the Bakorian War source, while preserving ''Perastan-Astorian War'' as an alias.

== Source Limits ==

The full chronology, dates, commanders, and outcome of the Pesteran-Astorian War are not yet fixed in the local draft set. This page exists to preserve the immediate consequence of the Bakorian War and to flag the naming issue for later canon review.
